item.title: About this Blog
item.description: The goal of this blog is to host short, informal articles about the Chapel parallel programming language. Over time, you can expect to see articles teaching language concepts, describing new features or performance results, sharing user experiences, reporting on community events, and other Chapel-related topics. Our intent is that this will be a space for more in-depth content than our Twitter or Facebook feeds can handle, and in more of a browse-at-your-own-speed format than our YouTube channel.
